acceptance: New scripts/series-status.mjs reads a repo root (tasks/*.json + events.jsonl) and prints one JSON object with: per-task attempts and run outcomes, tasks attempted/completed/blocked counts, and failure categories grouped by blocker text and event type (task_failed, run_interrupted, retry_exhausted, anomaly surfaced)
The tool reports raw categories and counts only; it does NOT auto-classify runner-caused vs task-caused (that judgment belongs to the orchestrator's close-out per the F6 classification table)
New scripts/series-status.test.mjs covers fixture boards: all-completed board, board with interrupted + blocked tasks, board with a failed run; all assertions pass
npm test passes with 0 failures and the pass count increased by the new tests
No existing script's behavior changed; builder works only on the isolated claim branch; no task record or events file touched by the builder; no merge and no PR by the builder
